The Jayhawks, members of the [[Big 12 Conference]], played their home games at [[Allen Fieldhouse]] in [[Lawrence, Kansas]]. They were led by 23rd year [[Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame|Hall of Fame]] head coach [[Bill Self]]. [[Jacque Vaughn]] served as acting head coach for Kansas' January 20, 2026 game against the Colorado Buffaloes as Self recovered from a health-related incident. ==Offseason== ===Coaching staff changes=== [[Norm Roberts]] announced his retirement on May 5, 2025, after 14 seasons with Kansas.{{cite web |title=Norm Roberts Retirement |date=October 24, 2025 |url=https://kuathletics.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/coaches/norm-roberts/729}} Former Kansas guard and NBA player Jacque Vaughn was announced as the replacement. He previously served as head coach in the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] with the [[Orlando Magic]] and [[Brooklyn Nets]].{{cite web |title=Kansas Great Jacque Vaughn Named Men's Basketball Assistant Coach |date=October 24, 2025 |url=https://kuathletics.com/news/2025/5/21/mens-basketball-kansas-great-jacque-vaughn-named-mens-basketball-assistant-coach}} On August 16, 2025, it was announced that Chase Buford had accepted an assistant coaching post with the NBA’s Denver Nuggets.{{cite web |title=KU basketball assistant coach Chase Buford accepts job with NBA’s Denver Nuggets |url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article311725767.html}} On August 20, 2025, it was announced that Tony Bland had been hired to fill the vacancy.{{cite web |title=Tony Bland Joins KU Men’s Basketball Staff as Assistant Coach |url=https://kuathletics.com/news/2025/8/20/mens-basketball-tony-bland-joins-ku-mens-basketball-staff-as-assistant-coach}} ===Graduating players=== Players listed below were seniors from the previous season who either have run out of eligibility or seniors with an extra year of eligibility due to the COVID-19 pandemic who have not announced a return to the team.
